# Abhiuday Gupta — Systems & AI Engineer
> Personal platform, systems architecture, and engineering blog by Abhiuday Gupta.

## Core Information
- Author: Abhiuday Gupta (Bengaluru, India)
- Focus: Bare-metal Go, Rust systems, Linux kernel primitives (systemd, cgroups v2), and autonomous coding agent runtimes under token budgets.
- Website: https://www.abhiudayg.dev

## Systems & Open-Source Projects

- [Anode](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev): Docker Compose & Kubernetes alternative for Go backends. Deduces infrastructure topology via Go SSA analysis and runs on Linux systemd & cgroups v2 with <8.2ms cold boots. Repository: https://github.com/abhiudayg/anode
- [Tekmor](https://github.com/autonomic-ai-dev/tekmor): Hard-gate verification engine & cryptographic test ledger. Intercepts tool calls via host stop hooks and records cryptographic receipts to eliminate hallucinated test passes.
- [Shipnote](https://shipnote.abhiudayg.dev): Provenance-backed technical drafting engine from public git commits with verified claim grounding against diffs. Repository: https://github.com/abhiudayg/shipnote
- [Agentrun](https://github.com/autonomic-ai-dev/agentrun): Isolated coding agent environments on macOS using native Apple container sandboxes and git worktrees.
- [Thesmos](https://github.com/autonomic-ai-dev/thesmos): Deterministic workflow DAG engine and state machine executing declarative YAML graphs with Tarjan SCC acyclicity validation.
- [Harbor](https://github.com/autonomic-ai-dev/harbor): Open-source, agent-native macOS browser on WebKit with explicit permission engines and local MCP server.

## Bare-Metal & Systems Scripts

- [Loopback Sharding: Three Services, Zero Port Collisions](https://www.abhiudayg.dev/scripts/loopback/): Give multiple local services their own IP in the 127.0.0.0/8 subnet and route by hostname with Caddy or Nginx without port collisions. Direct script: `curl -fsSL https://www.abhiudayg.dev/scripts/loopback.sh | bash`

## Key Engineering Dispatches

- [Why We Ditched Docker for Go Backends](https://www.abhiudayg.dev/blog/why-we-ditched-docker-for-go-backends/): 55x faster cold starts (<8.2ms) by running compiled Go binaries directly under Linux systemd and cgroups v2.
- [Inside the SSA Compiler Core](https://www.abhiudayg.dev/blog/inside-the-ssa-compiler-core/): Deducing databases, routes, and ports in ~60ms without YAML using Go SSA Variable Type Analysis.
- [Tekmor: The Architectural Pivot](https://www.abhiudayg.dev/blog/agent-brain-the-architectural-pivot-and-runtime/): Why polite prompts fail in coding agents, and how host pre-tool hooks enforce hard verification gates.
- [Tekmor: Memory Scopes & Reinforcement](https://www.abhiudayg.dev/blog/agent-brain-memory-scopes-and-reinforcement/): Preventing context bloat by splitting global vs project memory scopes and expiring stale facts.
- [Building Dustmap: Sub-12ms Disk Visualizer](https://www.abhiudayg.dev/blog/dustmap-disk-space-visualizer-rust-tauri/): Flat memory arrays, zero pointer chasing, and Rayon parallel file traversal.
- [Tekmor: Local MCP Routing](https://www.abhiudayg.dev/blog/agent-brain-local-mcp-routing/): Routing tool calls deterministically over stdio MCP.
